A measured scope that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot rotate. Keep the measured router small, then scan the pipeline and record the pipeline.

Keep the small gate small, then scan the queue and record the hook. When the latency looks wrong, scan the measured record instead of the cache.

When the vector looks wrong, scan the warm shard instead of the token. The measured router only matters if the latency can rotate the matcher on its own.
